name: The Microbe Mind
effect: Boosting this layer-13 neuron pulls every answer into the microscopic world of bacteria, dust mites, spores and particles, and the model starts treating the user as something microscopic.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
